# Thermal characteristics

The maximum overheat ΔTmax is no higher than 2 K at a current of 5 A.
The input filter capacity is 10 μFarad, the shunt resistance 5 kΩ.
The time constant is τ = RC; at σ = 3 μm the spread stays within tolerance.
The cross-section area is πr², where r is measured in mm.

The interface runs at 100 Mbit/s, the latency is 20 ms, the drive holds 2 TB.
The method `getUserById` returns `null` when the record is not in PostgreSQL.
The configuration is read from `1С:Предприятие 8.3` through CSV in UTF-8.
